title: Genre presets

profiles.profile: Routine collection and conversion should read cheaply and clearly; reserve contrast for meaningful capacity, unlock and milestone transitions.
profiles.priorities: Pickup/counter convergence and explicit state confirmation.
profiles.main risk: Many repeated pickups and nearby players; combine low-importance feedback and keep a stable current balance.
profiles.application: Avoid max-tier reward spectacle on every click; test repetition and motivation instead of assuming escalation helps.
profiles.evidence level: inference: proposed project profile, not validated genre-wide numeric defaults

profiles.profile: Structural change is the primary event; sell mass with large pieces, cause-following secondary breaks and material response.
profiles.priorities: Fracture location, moving mass, new openings and residual hazards.
profiles.main risk: Dust and overlapping debris can hide traversal; preserve escape routes and surviving targets.
profiles.application: Spend on readable silhouette and staged fragments before fine particles. Profile crowded collapses and cleanup.
profiles.evidence level: inference: proposed project profile, not validated genre-wide numeric defaults

profiles.profile: Threat, hit confirmation and opponent state outrank theme.
profiles.priorities: Truthful telegraph, trackable projectile, contact result, owner/team distinction.
profiles.main risk: Many players and skins; reduce unrelated cosmetic layers while preserving opponent threat information.
profiles.application: Keep attack cadence and input readability intact. Critical/final feedback must not hide the next live threat.
profiles.evidence level: inference: proposed project profile, not validated genre-wide numeric defaults

profiles.profile: Use absence, contrast and restrained motion to support uncertainty without obscuring required information.
profiles.priorities: Source-local atmosphere, readable danger state, sparse anomalies.
profiles.main risk: Dark environments can make every emissive fleck dominant; fog may hide navigation.
profiles.application: Use atmosphere outside decision-critical areas. Avoid repetitive flashes and forced disorienting camera effects.
profiles.evidence level: inference: proposed project profile, not validated genre-wide numeric defaults

profiles.profile: Navigation and platform boundaries lead; movement VFX support timing and destination.
profiles.priorities: Takeoff, landing, dash destination, checkpoints and failure states.
profiles.main risk: Speed lines, bloom and trails can cover platform edges.
profiles.application: Maintain stable camera and clear path in reduced motion. Do not let decorative trails imply traversable geometry.
profiles.evidence level: inference: proposed project profile, not validated genre-wide numeric defaults

profiles.profile: Build-state change and resource flow should be immediately attributable to a cause.
profiles.priorities: Placement confirmation, completed machine, resource transfer and unlock.
profiles.main risk: Dense machines plus counters create competing motion and constant loops.
profiles.application: Keep ambient machine effects subordinate and local; milestone VFX ends in a stable completed state.
profiles.evidence level: inference: proposed project profile, not validated genre-wide numeric defaults

profiles.profile: The current lethal hazard and safe route have priority over spectacle.
profiles.priorities: Truthful hazard boundary/state, directional threat, structural change and navigation.
profiles.main risk: Large weather, collapse and multiplayer effects coincide.
profiles.application: Degrade cosmetic smoke/debris before threat geometry. Test the worst overlap at low quality and on phones.
profiles.evidence level: inference: proposed project profile, not validated genre-wide numeric defaults

profiles.profile: Use graphic silhouettes, directional accents and cadence contrast inside a coherent combat vocabulary.
profiles.priorities: Readable attack preparation, distinct impact, held graphic shape and designed breakup.
profiles.main risk: Impact frames, speed lines and saturated effects can stack into an unreadable flash field.
profiles.application: Treat stepped cadence and high contrast as contextual style choices. Do not assume cinematic inversion flashes are safe or gameplay-readable.
profiles.evidence level: inference: proposed project profile, not validated genre-wide numeric defaults

intro: These eight profiles are proposed emphases for project testing. They do not prescribe universal particle counts, colours, timings or shake values.
